The Central Bank of India has announced the Central Bank Apprentice Result 2026 on 27th July 2026 the official website. Candidates who appeared in the CBI Apprentice Exam can now download the result PDF using their login credentials. A total of 3655 candidates have been qualified for the next round i.e. Language Proficiency Test. Scroll down to get the direct link to download the Central Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026, steps to download, next step and more.

Central Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Out

The Central Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026 has been released on the Central Bank official website for the exam held on 5th July 2026. The result contains the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next round. Candidates who have been shortlisted have to report to their allotted Regional Office for document verification and other joining formalities. As per the notice, candidates need to report on 30 July or 31 July 2026 and the apprenticeship training will begin from 1 August 2026.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026 PDF

The CBI Apprentice Result 2026 has been released in PDF format for the candidates to check their qualification status. Candidates can check their roll number by searching using Ctrl+F shortcut. If your roll number appears in the PDF it means you’ve qualified for the Documnet Verification round to be held on 30th & 31st July 2026. Click on the link below to download Central Bank Apprentice Result PDF.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026 PDF: Click to Download

How to Download CBI Apprentice Result 2026?

Students can check the Central Bank Apprentice Result 2026 using the link given above or go to the official Central Bank Portal and follow the steps given below.

  1. Visit the official website at centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the Recruitment section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link as “Declaration of Result—Engagement of Apprentices FY 2026-27.”
  4. A PDF containing the selected candidates list will open with roll number.
  5. Use Ctrl+F to search for your roll number in the PDF.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on CBI Apprentice Result PDF

The Central Bank of India Apprentice Result PDF consists of the roll number of the candidate selected for the upcoming eligibility test. Candidates can find the roll number and allotted regional office of the selected candidates.

What After the Central Bank Apprentice Result?

Candidates who qualify in the online exam have to appear for the Local Language Proficiency Test and document verification before the final selection. They need to do the following things after the release of the results.

  • Report to allotted Regional Office on 30 July or 31 July 2026.
  • Carry all original documents along with self attested photocopies for verification.
  • Bring your KYC documents, educational certificates, call letter, medical fitness certificate and other required documents.
  • Carry four recent passport size color photographs.

Central Bank Apprentice 2026 Result FAQs

Q. When was Central Bank Apprentice Exam 2026 held?

Ans: The Central Bank of India Apprentice Online Exam 2026 was held on 5th July 2026.

Q. How many candidates are shortlisted in CBI Apprentice Result 2026?

Ans: A total of 3655 candidates have been shortlisted to appear for Language Proficiency Test.

Q. When will Central Bank Document Verification round be held?

Ans: CBI Apprentice Document verification is scheduled for 30 July and 31 July 2026.

Q. When is Central Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026 released?

Ans: The CBI Apprentice Result 2026 was released on 27th July 2026 on the CBI website.
